chunks: 2969 - And it was narrated from al-Bazanti that he said:
A man asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام about a man performing hajj on behalf of another man, whether he names him by his name.
He said: “Allah, Mighty and Majestic, nothing hidden is concealed from Him.”

key_terms.الْبَزَنْطِيِّ: al-Bazanti, the narrator from whom this report is transmitted

ai.seo_question: When performing hajj on behalf of someone else, must I mention the person’s name explicitly?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses performing hajj on behalf of another person and whether explicitly naming that person is necessary. The Imam عليه السلام answers by affirming Allah’s complete knowledge, indicating that Allah knows the intended person even without explicit verbal designation.
